dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Well, I wish I could've become a Champion Duelist, but that's not happening in this life, I reckon.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: I can't fight — like, I really can't. I'm the type who can knock herself on the head with a sheathed sword...

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: But if there's a talent I do have, that's searching. As long as the case details are clear, I can quickly find all the relevant legal clauses.
